title: CSV reading: phit and phibble
label: CSV reading
description: Read one CSV file into PHP values with guessed types: Phit\read_csv(), phibble's DataFrame::fromCsv() using phit, and phibble with its own PHP reader.
workload: 1,000,000 rows, 46 MB: id int, key int, g string, x float with ~2% NA, t datetime

dataset.columns: id int, key int, g string, x float with ~2% NA, t datetime

method: One read of the whole file into PHP values, types guessed; process startup excluded. Memory covers the whole process. Each reader runs in its own process.
memory_method: Peak of the process's anonymous resident memory (RssAnon in /proc), sampled every millisecond by bench/peakmem.c; the peak resident set size, file pages included, from getrusage.

check.reader_used: each run reports whether Phit\read_csv() was available, and the runner asserts it
